name: Black Bunny
description: They are well-behaved and quiet, so they don't need to be fed more than the usual amount. They are smart and obedient, but also stubborn.

name: Husky
description: Active, yet calm at times. Can be moderately fed. Very smart in general.

name: Porcupine
description: A small, furry creature with very, very sharp spikes. A lovable pet.

name: Jr. Reaper
description: This spooky little harvester of souls is happy to come along for the ride!

name: Snowman
description: An adorable Snowman that is also very active. May seem a little rude at times, but the more it is loved, the more affable it becomes.

name: Orange Tiger
description: They are very gentle and obedient in nature, easily becoming friendly with the owner, which in turn speeds up the level-up process.

name: Skunk
description: Calm and quiet by nature, the easy-going, eccentric Skunk has a rather humorous and pompous outlook on life, the finer things are what it enjoys.

name: Kino
description: A happy-go-lucky, orange mushroom that loves shiny stones.

name: Gorilla Robo
description: Mysterious magical powers aligned and sucessfully evolved the Baby Robo into the rare and majestic Gorilla Robo!

name: Crys.Rudolph
description: The star of this year's Holidays. Projects an aura of nobility and gentleness. Only available during the winter Holidays!

name: Toucan
description: A trustworthy pet who is equally quick-witted. Unlike its masculine appearance, it is prone to insecurity and shyness.

name: White Duck
description: Silly and foolish, but hard working and easy-going by nature, White Duck is easy to please, and enjoys good food and a swim.

name: Golden Pig
description: It is a cute Golden Pig that brings luck to you.

name: Snail
description:
A snail that is really hard to figure out. The pet's skills will disappear once its magic runs out.
If you double-click the Snail after its magic duration ends, it will disappear.

Caution! This pet cannot have its magic duration extended after it ends.

name: Snail
description: A snail that is really hard to figure out. The pet's skills will disappear once its magic runs out.

name: Auto HP Potion Skill
description:
Allows your pet to use your HP potions on you when your HP falls below the threshold that you set. 
Can be used on all pets that do not have this skill.

name: Auto MP Potion Skill
description:
Allows your pet to use your MP potions on you when your MP falls below the threshold that you set.
Can be used on all pets that do not have this skill.

name: Auto Move Skill
description:
Adds a skill that allows your pet to automatically pick up nearby items and mesos without you having to move.
Can be used on pets with Meso Magnet or Item Pouch.

name: Expanded Auto Move Skill
description:
Triples your pet's auto move distance.
Can only be used on pets with the Auto Move Skill. Cannot be stacked.

name: AP Reset Scroll
description: Resets all stats, including AP invested in HP/MP.

name: SP Reset Scroll
description: When used, resets all skills except for beginner skills.

name: Storage Room 5-slot Coupon
description: Double-click to expand your Storage Room by 5 slots. You can have up to 150 slots.

name: Selective 5-slot Coupon
description:
Double-click to expand one of your tabs (Equip, Use, Set-up, Etc) by 5 slots.
Each tab can be expanded up to a total of 150 slots.

name: To My Dear Hero Package
description: Double-click to obtain the following items:

name: Regular Store Permit
description:
Allows you to open a regular store in which you can list up to 12 items at once. Can be used in fields or the Free Market.
If you are attacked or killed by a monster, the store will close.

name: Summer Store Permit
description:
This special-edition coupon allows you to open a sky-blue tree store in which you can list up to 18 items at once. Can be used in fields or the Free Market. Available for a limited time only.
If you are attacked or killed by a monster, the store will close.

name: Pink Store Permit
description:
This special-edition coupon allows you to open a pink tree store in which you can list up to 18 items at once. Can be used in fields or the Free Market. Available for a limited time only.
If you are attacked or killed by a monster, the store will close.

name: Fall Store Permit
description:
This special-edition coupon allows you to open an orange tree store in which you can list up to 18 items at once. Can be used in fields or the Free Market. Available for a limited time only.
If you are attacked or killed by a monster, the store will close.

name: Spring Store Permit
description:
This special-edition coupon allows you to open a green tree store in which you can list up to 18 items at once. Can be used in fields or the Free Market. Available for a limited time only.
If you are attacked or killed by a monster, the store will close.

name: Special Store Permit
description:
This special-edition coupon allows you to open a premium store in which you can list up to 24 items at once. Can be used in fields or the Free Market. Available for a limited time only.
If you are attacked or killed by a monster, the store will close.

name: Smiley Sun
description: A special effect that shows a brightly smiling sun floating over you. Double-click on the icon or designate a Hotkey via KeyConfig to toggle the effect on/off.

name: Moon & the Stars
description: A special effect that shows a brightly smiling moon floating in a sea of stars over you. Double-click on the icon or designate a Hotkey via KeyConfig to toggle the effect on/off.

name: Colorful Rainbow
description: A special effect that shows a rainbow with its full 7 colors floating next to you. Double-click on the icon or designate a Hotkey via KeyConfig to toggle the effect on/off.

name: Little Devil
description: A special effect that shows Lilly the cute little devil floating next to you. Double-click on the icon or designate a Hotkey via KeyConfig to toggle the effect on/off.

name: Underwater
description: A special effect that shows a submarine under the water. Double-click on the icon or designate a Hotkey via KeyConfig to toggle the effect on/off.

name: Shadow Style
description: Traces of the character remain when the character moves, creating multiple images of the character in the process. Double-click on the icon or designate a Hotkey via KeyConfig to toggle the effect on/off.

name: Glimmer of the Founder
description: A faint light for those newly arrived in the Classic World. Double-click on the icon or designate a Hotkey via KeyConfig to toggle the effect on/off.

name: Glow of the Founder
description: A bright light for those newly arrived in the Classic World. Double-click on the icon or designate a Hotkey via KeyConfig to toggle the effect on/off.

name: Radiance of the Founder
description: A brilliant light for those newly arrived in the Classic World. Double-click on the icon or designate a Hotkey via KeyConfig to toggle the effect on/off.
